problem_statement: What does the `default` key under `models` mean?

issue.title: What does the `default` key under `models` do?
issue.body: Reading the config docs I see a `models:` block with a `default:` key and a few per-task keys next to it. Which one wins for a task that isn't listed? Just want to understand the precedence — not a bug.
